headline: Internal Governance Conflict Surges into Open at India's Tata Group
summary: A leadership conflict over strategic direction and control of Tata Group has surfaced publicly following more than a year of private deliberations within the conglomerate.
why: Tata Group is India's largest corporate conglomerate, with businesses spanning information technology, automotive manufacturing, steel production, and retail.

impacts.name: Tata Motors
impacts.why: Executive governance uncertainty can weigh on conglomerate capital planning and investor sentiment.
